source_text: Designed for urban and suburban lines, the Meralis L12 is a single-car, low-floor passenger rail vehicle. Its Compact layout is 18.6 m in length, 2.65 m in width and 3.45 m in height. Capacity is 32 seated passengers and up to 66 standing passengers. The vehicle has a maximum speed of 70 km/h and is built for 1,000 mm track gauge. A battery-electric drive supports operation beneath the overhead supply and short sections without it.
